articles.title: At 91, 'Grey Beard' Reclaims His Appalachian Trail Record
articles.summary: Dale Sanders, 91, just became the oldest person to hike the entire 2,198-mile Appalachian Trail. The 359-day trek included 71 falls — and one final tumble near the summit.

articles.title: Nearly 1,500 Student Podcasts, One Big Question: What Is America?
articles.summary: NPR's Student Podcast Challenge received nearly 1,500 entries from kids in 42 states. Finalists tackled memory, technology, grief, and what it means to be American.

articles.title: Hailee Steinfeld Casts a Spell: Disney's 'Hexed' and a Record-Breaking Year
articles.summary: Hailee Steinfeld voices a teen witch in Disney's new animated film 'Hexed,' out Thanksgiving. She told Jimmy Fallon it's a 'dream come true' after a huge year with 'Sinners.'
